sentiment.rationale: The document shows a mixed forward outlook. Guidance for 2026 organic revenue growth of 4%-5% and comparable currency-neutral EPS growth of 5%-6% is in line with the long-term algorithm, not raised. Management explicitly flags headwinds including a new excise tax in Mexico, divestiture impacts, and weaker consumer demand in key markets like China and India. While there is some positive momentum (e.g., North America margin expansion, value share gains), the cautious guidance and explicit risk disclosures prevent a higher score. The score is slightly positive due to the maintained guidance and some operational momentum, but not above 0.15 because guidance was not raised and risks are clearly stated.

summary.revenue: Full year 2025 net revenues grew 2% to $47.9 billion; organic revenues grew 5%. Q4 net revenues grew 2% to $11.8 billion; organic revenues grew 5%.
summary.eps: Full year 2025 comparable EPS grew 4% to $3.00; Q4 comparable EPS grew 6% to $0.58.
summary.guidance: 2026: organic revenue growth of 4%-5%; comparable currency-neutral EPS growth of 5%-6% (excluding M&A); comparable EPS growth of 7%-8% versus $3.00 in 2025. Expects 1-point currency tailwind to net revenues and 3-point tailwind to EPS. Divestitures expected to be a 4-point headwind to net revenues and 1-point headwind to EPS.
summary.margin: Full year 2025 comparable operating margin expanded approximately 50 basis points to 31.2% (from 30.0% in prior year). Q4 comparable operating margin was 24.4% versus 24.0% in prior year.
key_risks: New excise tax in Mexico implemented at start of 2026, expected to pressure volume.
Divestitures (sale of Coca-Cola Beverages Africa and CHI Nigeria) expected to be a back-half weighted headwind to net revenue and EPS in 2026.
Consumer demand in major markets like China and India did not recover to pre-pandemic levels.
Revenue and profit declined in Asia Pacific during Q4 due to softer consumer spending and weaker industry performance.
Currency headwinds impacted 2025 results (5-point headwind to comparable EPS).
key_opportunities: North America achieved 30% operating margin for the first time, with volume, revenue, and operating income all increasing.
Value share gains for the nineteenth consecutive quarter in 2025.
Innovation and brand portfolio expansion (added 12 billion-dollar brands since 2017, totaling 32).
Expected currency tailwinds in 2026 (1-point to net revenues, 3-point to EPS).
Planned investments in innovation, digital, and capacity (e.g., fairlife, concentrate business).
